text_en: To the leader: according to Jeduthun. Of Asaph. A Psalm.
text_cn: 阿撒夫的诗歌，交与乐官耶杜通。

text_en: I cry aloud to God, aloud to God, that he may hear me.
text_cn: 我呼号，我的呼声上达天主前， 我向天主高呼，求他俯听矜怜。

text_en: In the day of my trouble I seek the Lord; in the night my hand is stretched out without wearying; my soul refuses to be comforted.
text_cn: 我在患难之日，寻求上主， 虽整夜伸手，亦不觉辛苦， 我的心灵且不接受安抚。

text_en: I think of God, and I moan; I meditate, and my spirit faints. Selah
text_cn: 我一怀念天主，即咨嗟哀叹， 我一沉思考虑，即心灰意懒。 （休止）

text_en: You keep my eyelids from closing; I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
text_cn: 你使我的眼睛彻夜不眠， 我实烦燥难安，苦不堪言。

text_en: I consider the days of old, and remember the years of long ago.
text_cn: 我回忆往昔的时日， 我怀念过去的岁月。

text_en: I commune with my heart in the night; I meditate and search my spirit:
text_cn: 我的心灵夜间默默自问， 我的神魂时时沉思质询：

text_en: “Will the Lord spurn forever, and never again be favorable?
text_cn: 难道天主永远拒绝， 难道不再回顾怜爱？

text_en: Has his steadfast love ceased forever? Are his promises at an end for all time?
text_cn: 难道他的恩爱永远停止， 他的诺言也将永世废弃？

text_en: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he in anger shut up his compassion? ” Selah
text_cn: 难道天主忘记了慈悲？ 因愤怒而将慈爱关闭？ （休止）

text_en: And I say, “It is my grief that the right hand of the Most High has changed. ”
text_cn: 因此我说：这是我的苦难： 至高者的右手已经改变。

text_en: I will call to mind the deeds of the Lord ; I will remember your wonders of old.
text_cn: 我现今追念上主的作为， 回想你往昔所行的奇迹；

text_en: I will meditate on all your work, and muse on your mighty deeds.
text_cn: 沉思你的一切所作所为， 更要默想你的一切异事。

text_en: Your way, O God, is holy. What god is so great as our God?
text_cn: 天主，你的行径完全在于圣化， 何神像我们的天主如此伟大？

text_en: You are the God who works wonders; you have displayed your might among the peoples.
text_cn: 只有你是施行奇迹的天主！ 在万民中彰显了你的威武。

text_en: With your strong arm you redeemed your people, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph. Selah
text_cn: 你以臂力拯救了你的人民， 就是雅各伯和若瑟的子孙。 （休止）

text_en: When the waters saw you, O God, when the waters saw you, they were afraid; the very deep trembled.
text_cn: 大水一旦看见你，天主， 大水一见你就都恐怖， 连深渊汪洋也都颤抖。

text_en: The clouds poured out water; the skies thundered; your arrows flashed on every side.
text_cn: 云天大雨倾降， 乌云发出巨响， 火箭满天飞翔。

text_en: The crash of your thunder was in the whirlwind; your lightnings lit up the world; the earth trembled and shook.
text_cn: 你的雷霆在旋风中发响， 闪电也将整个世界照亮， 大地惊慌失措而又摇荡。

text_en: Your way was through the sea, your path, through the mighty waters; yet your footprints were unseen.
text_cn: 你的道路虽然经过海底， 你的途径虽然穿越大水， 却没有显露出你的足迹。

text_en: You led your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
text_cn: 你曾藉着梅瑟和亚郎的手掌， 领导你的子民有如领导群羊。
